snippet.title: Stalingrad 1942 - InfinitByte Studios
snippet.description: Battle through endless enemy forces in this retro-inspired 16-bit arcade tank shooter. Defeat powerful bosses, collect power-ups, build massive combos, and survive as long as possible in a classic offline arcade experience from InfinitByte Studios.
